scenes.label: David’s houseboat
full: I live in a houseboat with my mum, dad and sister.
It’s got five rooms – a living room, a kitchen, a bathroom and two bedrooms.
We can play board games at my house, but we can’t skateboard or play football!
I like my house because at night I can hear the water and the ducks.

scenes.label: A house in the trees
full: I’ve got a treehouse in my garden and sometimes I sleep there.
It’s called a treehouse because it’s in the trees!
In the morning I can hear the birds.

scenes.label: Houses on the water
full: The houses in my village are lots of different colours and they are all on the water.
I like it because we can swim and catch fish.
easy: The houses in my village are lots of different colours and they are all on the water.
I like it because we can swim and catch fish.

scenes.label: A house that moves
full: My house has got four rooms – a living room, a kitchen, a bathroom and two bedrooms.
I like it because we can go to different places and take our house with us.
